profile.voice: Plain and direct. Short sentences, active verbs, one idea per paragraph. Opens with the job and why it fits, not with "I am writing to". Uses numbers for results ("600 staff", "from two days to an hour"). Warm but not gushing; avoids "passionate", "synergy" and long lists of adjectives. Closes with one line about what happens next.
profile.more: Wants a role with more security and identity work and less help desk. Happy with hybrid; prefers no more than two days a week on site.

documents.text:
Jordan Example
Example City, BC | 555-0100 | jordan@example.com

March 3, 2025
Hiring Team
Example Valley Library Co-op

Re: Systems Administrator

Your libraries run on a small team and a lot of goodwill, and the posting says you need someone who can keep the network steady while making the next upgrade easier than the last one. That is the work I like best.

At Mossbank Freight Lines I look after 140 servers for 600 staff. When builds took two days, I moved them to Terraform and Ansible; they now take an hour, and anyone on the team can run one.

I would be glad to talk about what your branches need this year.

Jordan Example

answers.about: I'm a systems administrator. I've done six years in IT, first support at a college, now running servers and identity for a freight company. I like automating things. I want to do more security work.

drafts.about:
Works: it's short and ends on what you want next.
Tighten: lead with the result, not the title, and name one thing you automated.
Stronger: "I keep 600 people signed in safely and their servers running. Over six years I've gone from college support to running identity for a freight company, where I moved our server builds from two days to an hour. Next I want a role that's mostly security."

guides.summary: Wants the next role to be mostly security work. Enjoys automation most; the Terraform move is the example to lead with.

drafts.headline: Systems Administrator | Identity and access, hybrid cloud, automation | Phishing-resistant sign-in for 600 staff
drafts.about:
I keep people signed in safely and their systems running.

For six years I've looked after hybrid Windows and Linux environments, first in college IT support and now at a freight company, where I run 140 servers and the identity side for 600 staff. I rolled out conditional access and phishing-resistant sign-in with no rise in help desk tickets, and moved our server builds from two days to an hour with Terraform and Ansible.

I'm looking for a role that's mostly security and identity work, in a team that writes things down.

jobs.title: Cloud Systems Administrator
jobs.notes: Strong match for my hybrid virtualization and identity management background. The on-call rotation is bi-weekly with compensatory time off. Good opportunity to modernize their infrastructure orchestration.
jobs.posting:
Cascade Meridian Systems is seeking a skilled Cloud Systems Administrator to join our infrastructure operations group in Burnaby, BC. In this role, you will manage, monitor, and optimize our distributed hybrid cloud infrastructure across regional data facilities and hosted virtualization clusters.

Key Responsibilities:
- Administer and maintain enterprise cloud server environments, virtual networks, and distributed storage volumes.
- Implement declarative configuration scripts to automate server provisioning, patching routines, and system image deployment.
- Maintain central identity registries, role-based access permissions, and single sign-on authentication integrations.
- Monitor system health, performance metrics, and network utilization using enterprise telemetry dashboards.
- Participate in an on-call rotation to resolve critical system incidents and perform scheduled maintenance windows.

Required Qualifications:
- Three or more years of hands-on experience administering multi-tier enterprise systems in cloud or virtualized environments.
- Demonstrated proficiency with shell automation scripting, configuration management tools, and continuous delivery pipelines.
- Solid understanding of network protocols including routing fabrics, firewalls, load balancing, and private network tunnels.
- Strong troubleshooting abilities across server operating systems and database storage layers.
- A post-secondary diploma or bachelor degree in computer systems technology or equivalent practical experience.

We offer comprehensive dental and health benefits, annual professional development allowances, and flexible hybrid scheduling.

jobs.posting:

You will collaborate with clinical support technicians and regional network specialists to ensure continuous availability of central application servers and patient information databases.

Core Duties:

- Administer centralized storage area networks, routine snapshot schedules, and offsite disaster recovery replication.
- Manage enterprise directory services, multi-factor credential policies, and endpoint security profiles.

jobs.title: Information Security Administrator
jobs.notes: Working on application materials for this financial sector compliance and access management position. Their tech stack aligns directly with my security hardening and firewall auditing projects. Good progression path toward team lead.
jobs.posting:
Apex Point Financial is hiring an Information Security Administrator to safeguard our wealth management platforms and financial transaction networks in downtown Vancouver, BC. Reporting to the Director of Technology Risk, you will maintain security controls, monitor threat intelligence feeds, and conduct routine system vulnerability assessments.

Responsibilities:
- Monitor enterprise security telemetry, firewall activity logs, and intrusion prevention alerts across our distributed office network.
- Conduct regular vulnerability scans, analyze findings, and collaborate with infrastructure teams to prioritize remediation.
- Administer privileged access management vaults, public key infrastructure, and data encryption keys.
- Assist in testing incident response protocols and conducting simulated security breach exercises.
- Ensure technical security configurations comply with provincial financial regulations and corporate data governance policies.

Requirements:
- Three to five years of experience in system administration with a dedicated focus on information security.
- Deep familiarity with perimeter firewall architectures, secure network segmentation, and identity federation.
- Practical experience using automated vulnerability scanners and centralized log aggregation tools.
- Relevant professional security credentials or equivalent formal technical education.
- High ethical standards and rigorous attention to detail when auditing system access records.

We provide transit subsidy allowances, competitive annual bonuses, and hybrid working arrangements.
